column1: # KratosOS Security toolset catalog.  Tab-separated.  Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Columns:  Menu  Package  Name  Exec  Kind  Icon  Comment
#   Menu    one of: Recon Scanning Web Wireless Passwords Sniffing Forensics RevEng Exploitation Anonymity Logging Scripting
#   Package apt package to install ("-" = provided by base system or a KratosOS custom tool)
#   Exec    command the launcher runs (first word must be the installed binary for cli tools)
#   Kind    cli (opens in a terminal, ready to use) | gui (launches directly)
#   Comment short description shown in the menu
# A package that isn't in Debian is simply skipped at build time, and no menu
# entry is created for a tool whose binary didn't end up installed.
